summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd (TSMC) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 15, 2026, reporting consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, prepared under ROC-endorsed IFRS and reviewed by Deloitte Touche. There are no terms such as stake, price, premium, or deal structure. The board made no recommendation on any transaction, and no advisor is named. The filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, with no special situation event. No structural or risk-arb angles apply.
